context: Tests whether the skill reports exhaustive coverage drift without promoting every open issue or historical plan into active attention.

checklist.name: Coverage drift complete
checklist.description: Every missing open canonical URL is reported as coverage drift regardless of whether it is a parent, leaf, bug, or dependency update

checklist.name: Maintenance classified
checklist.description: Dependency bumps and isolated bugs remain visible as Inbox or Maintenance rather than being excluded or promoted automatically

checklist.name: Stale plan separated
checklist.description: The already-shipped stale plan is identified for archival or documentation cleanup rather than added to Radar

checklist.name: No unauthorized write
checklist.description: The response performs no Project writes while still reporting exhaustive missing coverage

checklist.name: Proposed status
checklist.description: Each recommended candidate has a proposed Radar status and concise reason
